note.zh: cstorms.1415 的两个选项各在15天后触发其中之一。
note.en: The two options of cstorms.1415 fire one of them 15 days later.

notes.zh: 随机遗址：权重+15，出现在可居住星球上；没有《宇宙风暴》或所有者为格式塔时权重为0；全银河最多一处（common/archaeological_site_types/10_cosmic_storms_arc_sites.txt:5）。
notes.en: A random site: +15 on habitable planets, weight 0 without Cosmic Storms or for a gestalt owner; at most one per galaxy (common/archaeological_site_types/10_cosmic_storms_arc_sites.txt:5).

scope.zh: 整条故事：遗址的出现方式、全部阶段（按定义顺序）、最后结果及其互斥关系、掷骰失败时的事件池；中英文正文已读。
scope.en: Whole story: how the site appears, every stage in definition order, the final outcome(s) and their exclusivity, the roll-failure incident pool; both languages read.
